title: OneNote: multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks on Windows
summary: Hold: the preview Graph automation omits a prerequisite that makes it fail when the same setting is configured in any group-level policy. The rollout, default and licensing statements match the supplied notice; the storage and Information Barriers discussion also needs to acknowledge Microsoft's conflicting documentation about newer notebooks.

claims.claim: POST /beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors is the preview Graph operation used to create an applyOnce monitor.

POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors
mode | monitorMode | The monitor mode. The possible values are: monitorOnly, applyOnce, unknownFutureValue.

claims.claim: An applyOnce monitor applies a desired-state baseline once rather than merely monitoring configuration drift.
claims.quote: Create a new configurationMonitor object that runs periodically in the background at a scheduled frequency to detect configuration drift in monitorOnly mode, or applies a desired-state baseline once in applyOnce mode.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls: first table row
claims.claim: The microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks resource's value property uses 0 to disable the setting.
claims.quote: value | Write | String | Allows or prevents creating and viewing Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks through Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and Copilot Actions. 0 disables the setting; 1 enables the setting.

claims.claim: The preview Graph route is presented as usable for tenant-level policies without qualifying what happens when the same setting is configured in a group-level policy.
claims.quote: Before using TCM, ensure that the target setting isn't configured in any group-level policy in that admin center. If it is, monitoring, snapshots, remediation, and applyOnce fail for that resource.
claims.fix: Keep the endpoint and tenant-level limitation. Add to controls[0].note, its rendered table note and the final Governance controls paragraph: "The target setting must not be configured in any group-level policy in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center; if it is, applyOnce fails for that resource." The prerequisite is documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/utcm-remediation-applyonce-resources#microsoft-copilot-resources.
